title: Lesson 2 Quiz: Markets, Sessions, and Liquidity

questions.text: Which time period offers the highest liquidity and volatility for a trader operating in Atlantic Standard Time?
options: 4:00 PM - 8:00 PM AST (after New York close)
questions.explanation: The London-New York overlap (9:30-11:30 AM AST) combines two major sessions, producing peak liquidity and volatility.

questions.text: Trading outside the London-New York overlap typically results in tighter bid-ask spreads due to lower competition.
questions.explanation: Bid-ask spreads are narrow during peak liquidity (the overlap) and widen off-peak, increasing transaction cost.
